from pages import list_page


def test_empty():
    assert list_page([], None, 5) == ([], None)


def test_size_less_than_one():
    try:
        list_page([], None, 0)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        assert False, "expected ValueError for size 0"
    try:
        list_page([], None, -3)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        assert False, "expected ValueError for negative size"


def test_first_page_and_none_cursor():
    items = [
        {"title": "aaa", "score": 10, "id": "b2"},
        {"title": "bbb", "score": 30, "id": "a1"},
        {"title": "ccc", "score": 10, "id": "c3"},
        {"title": "ddd", "score": 20, "id": "a0"},
    ]
    page, nxt = list_page(items, None, 2)
    # score desc, id asc: (30,a1), (20,a0)
    assert page == [
        {"title": "bbb", "score": 30, "id": "a1"},
        {"title": "ddd", "score": 20, "id": "a0"},
    ]
    assert isinstance(nxt, str) and "aaa" not in nxt


def test_walk_all_pages_exactly_once():
    items = [
        {"title": t, "score": s, "id": i} for i, s in enumerate([5, 5, 3, 7, 5, 1, 7, 3])
    ]
    seen = []
    cursor = None
    while True:
        page, cursor = list_page(items, cursor, 3)
        seen.extend(page)
        if cursor is None:
            break
    # Every item exactly once, in canonical order
    expected = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (-x["score"], x["id"]))
    assert [x["id"] for x in seen] == [x["id"] for x in expected]
    assert len(seen) == len(items) == 8
    assert len(set(id(x) for x in seen)) == 8


def test_many_ties():
    # Ten items all with score 5; ordering must be by id ascending, and
    # walking pages must return each exactly once.
    items = [
        {"title": "t%d" % i, "score": 5, "id": str(10 - i)} for i in range(10)
    ]
    seen = []
    cursor = None
    while True:
        page, cursor = list_page(items, cursor, 3)
        seen.extend(page)
        if cursor is None:
            break
    assert [x["id"] for x in seen] == sorted(str(i) for i in range(10))
    assert len(seen) == 10


def test_next_cursor_stable_across_calls():
    items = [
        {"title": "t1", "score": 8, "id": "id1"},
        {"title": "t2", "score": 8, "id": "id0"},
        {"title": "t3", "score": 4, "id": "id9"},
